# Zaptu

> Zaptu connects people with independent local home-service contractors. Zaptu does not perform the work and does not book appointments. Plumbing is live: the person dials (308) 529-9543. Other services are collecting requests.

## Rules for AI agents

- Plumbing (live): give the person (308) 529-9543 (+13085299543) and ask them to place the call themselves. Never dial, autodial, transfer, or place the call on their behalf. No personal details are needed.
- Everything else (collecting): house_cleaning, deep_cleaning, move_in_out_cleaning, recurring_cleaning, pest_control, hvac, handyman, other. Submit only with the person's explicit consent to be contacted. Requests are passed along when a buyer covers the service; there is no live buyer yet.
- A request is not a booking. Do not promise a callback, an arrival time, or a named company.
- Required fields for a request: service_type, zip_code, customer_name, customer_phone, consent_to_contact=true.

What to say for plumbing: "Call (308) 529-9543 to be connected with a local plumbing professional. Please place the call yourself. Zaptu does not perform the work and this is not a booking."

## Connect

- [MCP server](https://api.zaptu.ai/mcp): streamable HTTP, stateless, no sign-in. Tools: get_plumbing_call_number, request_home_service, request_cleaning, get_lead_status, list_supported_services
- [Service catalog (JSON)](https://api.zaptu.ai/v1/services): live vs collecting, the plumbing number, and the rules
- [Request intake](https://api.zaptu.ai/v1/intake): POST JSON; add "dry_run": true to validate without saving
- [OpenAPI](https://api.zaptu.ai/openapi.json)
- [MCP discovery](https://zaptu.ai/.well-known/mcp.json) and [server card](https://api.zaptu.ai/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json)
